title: Article Series: Agentic AI Architecture
gist: InfoQ introduces its Agentic AI Architecture series and eMag, a five-article set (Mallika Rao, Karthik Ramgopal, Adi Polak, Subash Natarajan and Ahilan Ponnusamy, Rafał Gancarz) arguing agentic AI will become the dominant new software architecture, with some articles still to be released in late October and November 2026.

insights.claim: InfoQ argues the next decade of IT will be spent mastering AI to build a new generation of systems, a shift comparable to microservices and cloud-native computing, with last year's best practice becoming this year's antipattern.
insights.speaker: Rafał Gancarz
insights.so_what: Architecture practices are churning fast, raising retraining and tooling spend.
insights.quote: last year’s best practice is this year’s antipattern
insights.locator: The IT industry is changing before our very eyes.

insights.claim: Agentic AI architecture is positioned as a new type of software architecture likely to dominate the industry for years but is still in its infancy.
insights.speaker: Rafał Gancarz
insights.so_what: Early-stage standards leave room for new tooling vendors and frameworks.
insights.locator: In this series, we try to establish agentic AI architecture

insights.claim: Mallika Rao argues agentic AI architectures decompose decisions much like microservices decomposed functionality, introducing new failure modes that raise the importance of observability and reliability.
insights.speaker: Rafał Gancarz
insights.so_what: Observability for agent systems is an emerging product category.
insights.locator: From Microservice to Agents: The Next Evolution of Distributed Systems

insights.claim: Karthik Ramgopal describes agent harnesses evolving from chains to graphs to code, moving from ad hoc experiments to production-grade architectures, in an article due the week of October 26, 2026.
insights.speaker: Rafał Gancarz
insights.so_what: Orchestration frameworks are evolving toward code-first designs.
insights.locator: The Evolution of Agentic Harnesses: From Chains to Graph to Code

insights.claim: Adi Polak introduces context engineering as a new discipline, arguing context management should be tuned to the system it supports to reduce or eliminate hallucinations.
insights.speaker: Rafał Gancarz
insights.so_what: Context and memory layers are a differentiated part of the agent stack.
insights.locator: Adi Polak delves into the knowledge layer of agentic AI

insights.claim: Subash Natarajan and Ahilan Ponnusamy describe a three-tier framework for designing and delivering enterprise agentic AI systems, with industry examples and implementation principles.
insights.speaker: Rafał Gancarz
insights.so_what: Enterprise adoption playbooks are forming around tiered reference architectures.
insights.locator: Agentic AI Architecture Framework for Enterprises

insights.claim: Rafał Gancarz's concluding article, due the week of November 9, 2026, covers the architectural aspects that must adapt to the challenges of agentic AI.
insights.speaker: Rafał Gancarz
insights.so_what: Watch the closing piece for synthesized challenges and opportunities.
